positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
• Tutor for Data Structure and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) classes 
• Assist students in assignments, class content review, and after-class discussions

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
• In a team of two, conceptualize, plan, and design branding products & social media advertisements (twelve products on average per month) 
• Otus Consulting is an education consultancy startup for Vietnamese high school students to overcome cultural, international, and financial barriers to gain college access

volunteerExperiences.companyName: STUDENT GOVERNMENT ASSOCIATION at VNU-HCM High School for the Gifted
volunteerExperiences.description:
• Collaborated with 7 other members to organize one to three school events each month for more than 1,000 students • Presented the events’ concept and detailed plan to the board of faculty advisor 
 • Led small groups of 3-15 volunteers to prepare the backdrops, stage, props, and to assist participants during events 
• Designed posters, banners, and backdrops for school events using Illustrator
